description: Original examples for trying Recall and learning the question-bank format.

questions.question: Which day appears first in this list: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday?
How many minutes are in one hour?
In your own words, what does a checklist help you do?
questions.answer: Keep track of the steps to do and notice any steps you have missed.
questions.explanation: Your wording can differ. Compare the ideas and rate your recall honestly.

reverse.question: Which abbreviation means first in, first out?

questions.question: Which two numbers in this group are even: 1, 2, 3, 4?
questions.explanation: Both 2 and 4 are required; neither 1 nor 3 is even.

questions.question: What do you call a saved copy kept so a file can be recovered?
questions.hint: Think about getting your data back after losing the working file.

questions.question: Explain the difference between Save and Undo.
questions.answer: Save keeps the current changes; Undo reverses the last change.

variants.question: Match each action to its meaning.
variants.answer: Save → Keep changes; Undo → Reverse the last change

questions.question: A timer starts with one hour. Thirty minutes pass. How many minutes remain?
questions.explanation: One hour is 60 minutes; 60 minus 30 leaves 30.

questions.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
